title: Physics of ULIRGs with MUSE and ALMA: The PUMA project. IV. No tight relation between cold molecular outflow rates and AGN luminosities
question: Determine the prevalence, properties, driving mechanisms (starburst vs. AGN, momentum- vs. energy-driven), and feedback effects of spatially resolved cold molecular outflows in nearby ULIRGs, and compare CO(2-1) outflow properties with OH 119 um outflow signatures.

recipe.goal: Generate CO(2-1) moment maps and peak emission maps, and determine systemic redshifts
recipe.method: Mask pixels in each velocity channel with S/N < 3.5-5 (noise from MAD); smooth each channel with a 3-pixel Gaussian kernel and mask pixels with S/N < 0.4 in the smoothed image to remove isolated spurious emission; compute moments 0, 1, and 2 from masked cubes and peak map from original cubes; set zero velocity from moment 1 at continuum peak.
key_parameters: Smoothing Gaussian kernel = 3 pixels; smoothed S/N threshold = 0.4

recipe.goal: Perform spectro-astrometry to determine disk kinematic major axis and identify decoupled high-velocity outflow gas
recipe.method: Bin velocity channels to achieve S/N >= 5; fit a 2D Gaussian to a 5x5 spaxel region around the peak spaxel (or full emission for targets with central dips) to get sub-pixel centroids; perform linear bisector fits to low-velocity (|v| < 300 km s^-1) centroids for the kinematic major axis PA and to high-velocity (|v| > 300 km s^-1) centroids for the outflow axis.
key_parameters: Minimum binned channel S/N = 5; fitting box = 5x5 spaxels
Velocity threshold separating low- and high-velocity channels: |v| = 300 km s^-1
assumptions: Centroid uncertainty delta_x = FWHM_beam / (2 * S/N) following Condon (1997)

recipe.goal: Define outflow velocity ranges and measure outflow sizes, velocities, masses, and energetics
recipe.method: Define [v_min, v_max] for blue and red wings where centroids deviate from rotation and integrated map S/N peaks; fit beam-convolved 2D Gaussian to integrated high-velocity maps to get R_out; extract spectrum within observed R_out and integrate flux in [v_min, v_max] to get F_out, L'_CO, and M_out; compute flux-weighted v_out, mass outflow rate M_dot_out, momentum rate, kinetic luminosity, and escape fraction.
key_parameters: Median values for 3-sigma upper limits: <v_out> = 390 km s^-1, <R_out> = 0.52 kpc
assumptions: Cosmology: Omega_Lambda = 0.7, Omega_M = 0.3, H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1
Line luminosity ratio r_21 = L'_CO(2-1)/L'_CO(1-0) = 0.91 and ULIRG CO-to-H2 conversion factor alpha_CO = 0.78 M_sun (K km s^-1 pc^2)^-1
Constant mass outflow rate over dynamical time t = R_out / v_out (volume density proportional to R^-2)
Average isotropic inclination corrections for sample means: 1/<sin(i)> = 1.27 for velocity, 1/<cos(i)> = 2 for radius, unity for dynamical time
Truncated isothermal sphere for escape velocity with <M_dyn> = 3.9e10 M_sun, r = 1 kpc, truncation radius = 2 * <R_e> = 4 kpc

recipe.goal: Fit archival Herschel/PACS OH 119 um doublet profiles and derive percentile velocities
recipe.method: Extract spectra from central 9.4"x9.4" spaxel with point-source aperture correction; normalise to linear continuum fit; fit two double-Gaussian components (systemic+outflow in absorption, emission, or P-Cygni) convolved with instrumental resolution; derive v_50, v_84, and v_98 percentile velocities and estimate errors with 50 Monte Carlo iterations.
key_parameters: Lambda-doublet rest-frame separation = 0.208 um; Herschel/PACS instrumental resolution FWHM ~ 270 km s^-1; 50 Monte Carlo realisations
assumptions: Zero velocity of OH spectra set to the CO(2-1) redshift; model absorption constrained not to be deeper than observed absorption

recipe.goal: Perform statistical two-sample tests and MCMC linear bisector fits for outflow scaling relations
recipe.method: Compare outflow parameter distributions across AGN/SB and merger/interacting subsamples using survival analysis two-sample tests (Gehan, Logrank, Peto-Prentice) in ASURV; fit linear bisector relations between outflow properties, SFR, and v_out (including PHANGS-ALMA) using MCMC in PyStan.
key_parameters: MCMC settings: 2000 steps, 4 chains; systematic uncertainties: 0.1 dex on log v_out, 0.3 dex on log M_out, log M_dot_out, log eta, and log(M_out/R_out)
assumptions: SFR from L_IR (after removing AGN fraction alpha_AGN) using Kennicutt & Evans (2012) relation with Kroupa & Weidner (2003) IMF; SNe momentum and energy from Kim & Ostriker (2015) and Leitherer et al. (1999)

score_reason: All ALMA project codes, target coordinates, redshifts, integration times, beam sizes, sensitivities, and exact outflow velocity windows [v_min, v_max] are tabulated, and the analysis equations and MCMC fitting procedure are thoroughly documented; however, core ALMA calibration/imaging parameters are deferred to Paper II (Pereira-Santaella et al. 2021) and some channel-selection steps in spectro-astrometry are manual.
rediscovery_reason: All six ALMA project codes are public in the ALMA archive, Table 3 provides the exact velocity integration windows [v_min, v_max] for every outflow detection, and the main results (outflow masses, radii, velocities, outflow rates, and scaling slopes) are fully numeric.
